records.jp: あら、白井さん
records.en_original: Oh, Shirai.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Shirai.
records.en: Oh, Shirai-san.

records.jp: 史緒。あれからどう？<CR>音色は変わってきた？
records.en_original: Fumio. How have things been going? Has your music changed?
records.en_auxiliary: Fumio. How have things been going? Has your music changed?
records.en: Fumio. How have things been going? Has your music changed?

records.jp: うーん……あまり変わってないかも……？<CR>でも、そのまま言っちゃうとがっかりさせそうだし……
records.en_original: Hm... I don't think it's changed much...? But if I tell her that, she's going to be disappointed.
records.en_auxiliary: Hm... I don't think it's changed much? But if I tell her that, she's going to be disappointed.
records.en: Hm... I don't think it's changed much...? But if I tell her that, she's going to be disappointed.

records.jp: 心持ち、変わってきたような気がするわ
records.en_original: I feel like my approach has changed.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like my approach has changed.
records.en: I feel like my approach has changed.

records.jp: ……うん、それは良かった
records.en_original: ...Sure, that's good.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Sure, that's good.
records.en: ...Sure, that's good.

records.jp: 色んな場所に行って色んな音楽を聴いたけれど、<CR>得られるものは少なくなってきた感じね
records.en_original: I went to various places and listened to different music, but I feel like I don't have much else to gain.
records.en_auxiliary: I went to various places and listened to different music, but I feel like I don't have much else to gain.
records.en: I went to various places and listened to different music, but I feel like I don't have much else to gain.

records.jp: ここは一つ、音楽に関することからも全部離れて<CR>色んなことをしてみるべきかしら……
records.en_original: Perhaps I should get off the music train of thought entirely and look towards other venues for my inspiration...
records.en_auxiliary: Perhaps, I should get off the music train of thought entirely and look towards other venues for my inspiration.
records.en: Perhaps I should get off the music train of thought entirely and look towards other venues for my inspiration...

records.jp: ピアノの音色のためにそこまでやれるなんて、<CR>本当にすごい意欲だね……
records.en_original: Going that far just to change your approach to the piano is pretty ambitious.
records.en_auxiliary: Going that far just to change your approach to the piano is pretty ambitious.
records.en: Going that far just to change your approach to the piano is pretty ambitious.

records.jp: 理想の音を出すためなんだもの、当然だよ
records.en_original: I've gotta do it if I want to capture my ideal sound.
records.en_auxiliary: I must do it if I hope to capture my ideal sound.
records.en: I've gotta do it if I want to capture my ideal sound.

records.jp: 今の自分じゃダメってことはわかってるの。<CR>でも、何かすればするだけ変われるんだから！
records.en_original: I recognize that I can't do it as I am now, but the more things I do, the more I can change!
records.en_auxiliary: I recognize that I can't do it as I am now, but the more things I do, the more I can change!
records.en: I recognize that I can't do it as I am now, but the more things I do, the more I can change!

records.jp: そう、時には遠回りも大事。<CR>おばあ様もそう仰っていたわ
records.en_original: My grandmother told me that sometimes it's important to take the long road.
records.en_auxiliary: My grandmother told me that sometimes it's important to take the long road.
records.en: Yes. Sometimes taking the long way around is important. Grandmother said so too.

records.jp: ええ、今こうしている間にも、<CR>私は高みへと一歩ずつ進んでいるんだわ……！
records.en_original: That's right. Even talking this through with you, I'm taking steps towards even greater heights...!
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. Even talking this through with you, I'm taking steps towards even greater heights!
records.en: That's right. Even talking this through with you, I'm taking steps towards even greater heights...!

records.jp: よ、よかったね……
records.en_original: H-Happy to help...
records.en_auxiliary: H-happy to help.
records.en: H-Happy to help...

records.jp: さあ、さっそくやりたいことを書き出してみなくっちゃ！
records.en_original: Anyway, I need to write down what I want to do!
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, I need to write down what I want to do!
records.en: Anyway, I need to write down what I want to do!

records.jp: それで……やってみたいことは決まった？
records.en_original: So... Did you decide on what to do?
records.en_auxiliary: So... Did you decide on what to do?
records.en: So... Did you decide on what to do?

records.jp: それがね……全部挙げていたら、<CR>多すぎて決められなくなってしまって
records.en_original: Well... I made a list of all sorts of things, but it's so long that I can't make a decision.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I made a list of all sorts of things, but it's so long that I can't make a decision.
records.en: Well... I made a list of all sorts of things, but it's so long that I can't make a decision.

records.jp: そ、そうなんだ……
records.en_original: I-I see...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I see.
records.en: I-I see...

records.jp: こんな時こそ……そうだわ！
records.en_original: At times like this... That's right!
records.en_auxiliary: At times like this... That's right!
records.en: At times like this... That's right!

records.jp: この溢れ返る欲求、時間に追われる絶望、<CR>忍び寄るデスマの予感……
records.en_original: This brimming desire, this mounting dispair, this premonition of a death march creeping closer...
records.en_auxiliary: This brimming desire, this mounting despair, this premonition of a death march creeping closer...
records.en: This brimming desire, this mounting dispair, this premonition of a death march creeping closer...

records.jp: 今すぐ必要なのは――<CR>ずばり、トリアージね
records.en_original: The only solution...is triage!
records.en_auxiliary: The only solution... is triage!
records.en: The only solution...is triage!

records.jp: とりあーじ？
records.en_original: What's that?
records.en_auxiliary: What's that?
records.en: What's that?

records.jp: お父さんの会社で最近重視しているものよ
records.en_original: It's something that father's company stresses lately.
records.en_auxiliary: It's something that father's company stresses lately.
records.en: It's something Dad's company has been emphasizing lately.

records.jp: デスマーチを回避するため……<CR>仕事に優先順位をつけて必要なものを絞り込むの
records.en_original: To avoid the death march... It's necessary to prioritize your tasks and narrow your focus.
records.en_auxiliary: To avoid the death march... it's necessary to prioritize your tasks and narrow your focus.
records.en: To avoid the death march... It's necessary to prioritize your tasks and narrow your focus.

records.jp: ああ、なるほど……
records.en_original: Ah, I get it...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, I get it.
records.en: Ah, I get it...

records.jp: （この前、史緒はデスマーチの感覚を掴もうとして<CR>倒れちゃったんだっけ……その反省かな？）
records.en_original: (Fumio collapsed trying to understand the death march... Could this be some sort of atonement?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Fumio collapsed trying to understand the death march. Could this be some sort of atonement?)
records.en: (Fumio collapsed trying to understand the death march... Could this be some sort of atonement?)

records.jp: じゃあ、さっそくトリアージ開始！
records.en_original: Okay, time to begin the triage!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, time to begin the triage!
records.en: Okay, time to begin the triage!

records.jp: ……史緒？　どうしたの？
records.en_original: ...Fumio? What's wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: Fumio? What's wrong?
records.en: ...Fumio? What's wrong?

records.jp: ああ、だめ……<CR>何を優先すればいいか、全然わからない……
records.en_original: Oh, it's no good... I have no idea what to prioritize...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, it's no good. I have no idea what to prioritize.
records.en: Oh, it's no good... I have no idea what to prioritize...

records.jp: あ、あはは……
records.en_original: A-Ahaha...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, ahaha...
records.en: A-Ahaha...

records.jp: まず手始めにいくつかやってみるのはどう？<CR>そのうちに優先順位が見えてくるかもしれないし
records.en_original: You don't have to do the whole list all at once. Do a few and your priorities will fall into place.
records.en_auxiliary: You don't have to do the whole list all at once. Do a few and your priorities will fall into place.
records.en: You don't have to do the whole list all at once. Do a few and your priorities will fall into place.

records.jp: 白井さん……<CR>そうね、最初はそうなるのも仕方ないよね
records.en_original: Shirai... You're right, of course I have to do that first.
records.en_auxiliary: Shirai... You're right, of course I have to do that first.
records.en: Shirai-san... You're right, of course I have to do that first.

records.jp: ありがとう、白井さん。<CR>いくつかやってみることにするわ
records.en_original: Thank you. I've give a few of these a try.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you. I'll give a few of these a try.
records.en: Thank you, Shirai-san.<CR>I'll try a few of them.

records.jp: 一番興味のあるものから始めるのはどうかな。<CR>熱中したほうが気づけるものも多そうだし
records.en_original: How about starting with the one you're most interested in? I'm sure you can figure that out if you focus.
records.en_auxiliary: How about starting with the one you're most interested in? I'm sure you can figure that out if you focus.
records.en: How about starting with the one you're most interested in? I'm sure you can figure that out if you focus.

records.jp: 興味のあるもの……そうね、<CR>それが良さそうだわ！
records.en_original: Something I'm interested in... Right, that's brilliant.
records.en_auxiliary: Something I'm interested in... Right, that's brilliant.
records.en: Something I'm interested in... Right, that's brilliant.

records.jp: この中で一番興味あるものだと、やっぱり……<CR>うん、決めた！
records.en_original: The one I'm most interested in among these is... Yes, I've decided!
records.en_auxiliary: The one I'm most interested in among these is... Yes, I've decided!
records.en: The one I'm most interested in among these is... Yes, I've decided!

records.jp: ありがとう、白井さん！<CR>善は急げと言うし、すぐに始めてみるわ！
records.en_original: Thank you, Shirai! They say to strike while the iron is hot, so I'll start right away!
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Shirai! They say to strike while the iron is hot, so I'll start right away!
records.en: Thank you, Shirai-san! They say to strike while the iron is hot, so I'll start right away!

records.jp: あ、う、うん……！
records.en_original: Oh, s-sure...!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, s-sure!
records.en: Oh, s-sure...!

records.jp: ……史緒って、すごく行動力あるよね……
records.en_original: When Fumio takes action, she really takes action...
records.en_auxiliary: When Fumio takes action, she really takes action.
records.en: When Fumio takes action, she really takes action...

records.jp: それなら――
records.en_original: In that case...
records.en_auxiliary: In that case...
records.en: In that case...
